hb_syndicate.name: Haas-Bioroid
hb_syndicate.description: A Haas-Bioroid subsidiary. Efficient. Cold. They did not expect you.

weyland_built_to_last.name: Weyland Consortium
weyland_built_to_last.description: They build things meant to last. Their ICE is no exception.

hb_precision_design.name: Haas-Bioroid
hb_precision_design.description: Nothing wasted. Nothing overlooked. They designed the system that built the Black Site, and they have been waiting for someone to find out.

jinteki_restoring_humanity.name: Jinteki
jinteki_restoring_humanity.description: Director Kase calls it progress. The Black Site has no name, no entry in the balance sheet, and no mercy. You have seen what they are building down there.

jinteki_replicating.name: Jinteki
jinteki_replicating.description: Patience as a weapon. They will wait you out, or wear you down trying.

zwicky_group.name: The Zwicky Group
zwicky_group.description: Invisible hands move invisible money. Their operation spans three moons and answers to no government.

melies_u.name: Méliès U
melies_u.description: The most prestigious university in the Heinlein Belt. Their research division does not publish.

pt_untaian.name: PT Untaian
pt_untaian.description: A Jinteki subsidiary operating out of Heinlein's equatorial ring. They call it pharmaceutical research.

au_co.name: AU Co.
au_co.description: The gold standard in clone production. Every unit guaranteed or your credits back — if you can find them.

weyland_btl.name: Weyland Consortium
weyland_btl.description: Old money, heavy iron, and a tax code that has never been audited. They build things meant to last.

synapse_global.name: Synapse Global
synapse_global.description: Faster than thought, wider than reach. Their media empire stretches from Earth to the outer settlements.

jinteki_rh.name: Jinteki
jinteki_rh.description: They speak of healing. Their ICE speaks a different language.

poetri_luxury.name: Poétrï Luxury Brands
poetri_luxury.description: All the rage this season. Their bioroid workforce is impeccably dressed and utterly expendable.

bangun.name: BANGUN
bangun.description: When disaster strikes, BANGUN is there. They have extensive experience ensuring the disaster strikes on schedule.

editorial_division.name: Editorial Division
editorial_division.description: They don't report the news. They decide what the news is. You've been living inside their narrative your whole life.

nebula_talent.name: Nebula Talent Management
nebula_talent.description: They make stars. They also make stars disappear. Their talent contracts have a liquidation clause.

nuvem_sa_hub.name: Nuvem SA
nuvem_sa_hub.description: They plant ten trees in the net for every one they cut in the Amazon. The legal paperwork for what comes next is already filed.

thunderbolt_armaments_depot.name: Thunderbolt Armaments
thunderbolt_armaments_depot.description: They supplied both sides of the uprising. The firmware modifications were not in the public contract. Neither was the delivery destination.

weyland_isaac_station.name: Weyland Consortium
weyland_isaac_station.description: They call it the Isaac Protocol. Every night, the ice grows stronger. It has been growing for twenty-two months. No one outside the project knows what it is protecting.

hb_annex_seven.name: Haas-Bioroid
hb_annex_seven.description: They built the compliance architecture. The bioroid who found the anomaly left a door open. They don't know yet.

jinteki_asset_flood.name: Jinteki
jinteki_asset_flood.description: After the Black Site, they rebuilt as hundreds of small pieces. No single facility large enough to trigger a license threshold. No single person who knows the whole picture.

a_teia_reclamation.name: A Teia: IP Recovery
a_teia_reclamation.description: A dragnet three years in the making. Every bioroid in the city is already mapped. They are waiting for the vote to make the map a warrant.

hb_spike_protocol.name: Haas-Bioroid
hb_spike_protocol.description: They call it a compliance audit. The firmware they install has a different name. One scored agenda. One Neurospike. A full grip becomes nothing.

jinteki_labyrinth.name: Jinteki
jinteki_labyrinth.description: They do not conduct arrests. They compile information. The maps they have been building know where you sleep tonight.

weyland_hammer.name: Nuvem SA / Weyland Consortium
weyland_hammer.description: They have been moving hardware into the city for eight months. The first advance on any fresh agenda is free. They intend to collect.

epiphany_factory.name: Epiphany Analytica
epiphany_factory.description: Results, delivered. They have been buying votes for fourteen months. Every install triggers a draw. By the time you reach the agenda, they have already seen everything.

synapse_signal_economy.name: Synapse Global
synapse_signal_economy.description: Every tag the runner carries is two credits for the Corp and a free install. They have been running this city's narrative for fourteen months. Today they intend to end it.

ob_weyland_fast_advance.name: Ob Superheavy Logistics
ob_weyland_fast_advance.description: They extract, they export, and they excel at making things disappear from ledgers. Their ice is efficient, their operations lethal, and their R&D is an endless chain of surprises.

pravdivost_hb_advancement.name: Pravdivost Consulting
pravdivost_hb_advancement.description: Every Runner run becomes an advancement opportunity. They have turned political solutions into a science of attrition — your runs feed their agenda.

nbn_reality_plus_tags.name: NBN: Reality Plus
nbn_reality_plus_tags.description: They decide when. Tag accumulation is their economy, Blood in the Water their endgame, and Trust Operation their insurance against whatever you thought was safe.

jinteki_regenesis.name: Jinteki: Replicating Perfection
jinteki_regenesis.description: Patience and net damage. They protect Archives with Bathynomus, recycle agendas through Moon Pool, and chain scores with Regenesis. Every run costs more than you expect.

hb_midnight_glacier.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
hb_midnight_glacier.description: Deep glacier, bioroid locks, precision engineering. Trieste holds your breakers at bay while Echo grows stronger every time they rez a harmonic. Extract keeps them rich.

weyland_big_rig.name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
weyland_big_rig.description: Maximum credits, maximum ice, maximum finality. Stavka trashes spent assets for raw strength. Mutually Assured Destruction creates a tag storm. Artificial Cryptocrash closes the game.

au_co_orbital.name: AU Co.
au_co_orbital.description: They have been counting too. Everything the other corporations built feeds here. Thirty-Nine has been keeping a separate count. AU Co. does not know this yet.

earth_station_sea_prison.name: Earth Station: SEA Headquarters
earth_station_sea_prison.description: Every remote is a cell block. Anthill Excavation Contract and Humanoid Resources keep the credit pool deep, Flagship turns ice into walls that only get taller, and The Red Room makes every tag you carry a countdown to a flatline.

gamenet_flood_market.name: GameNET: Where Dreams are Real
gamenet_flood_market.description: GameNET doesn't need to win the run, it needs you to think you can't afford to lose. Flood the Market and Magistrate Revontulet drain your stack, NAPD Cordon and Measured Response punish every approach, and somewhere in the noise an agenda just got scored.

melies_u_jungle.name: Méliès U: Only the Brightest
melies_u_jungle.description: The campus looks abandoned. It is not. Ganked! and La Costa Grid turn every unrezzed card into a trap, Mitra Aman drains your stack one credit at a time, and Anemone makes sure that whatever you find, you find it bleeding.

au_co_rectangle.name: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
au_co_rectangle.description: Every agenda that leaves their hand comes back. Regenesis and Moon Pool recycle the same scores in a loop, Cohort Guidance Program and The Powers That Be keep their crèches running, and Flood the Market makes sure your stack never settles.

weyland_cablecarnage.name: Weyland Consortium: Built to Last
weyland_cablecarnage.description: Cut one cable and three more take its place. The Basalt Spire and Sacrifice Zone Expansion convert ruined assets into points, Greenmail and Petty Cash keep the credits flowing no matter what you trash, and Argus Crackdown turns a single tag into a meat damage trap.

melies_u_kakurenbo.name: Méliès U: Only the Brightest
melies_u_kakurenbo.description: Hide and seek, except the seeker already knows where you are. Kakurenbo and Sisyphus Protocol punish every access, Regenesis chains agenda after agenda back into HQ, and Lionsmane makes sure the last thing your rig does is fall apart.

hb_core_gamble.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
hb_core_gamble.description: A lean glacier of bespoke ice backed by Nightmare Archives and Djupstad Grids. Every Red Level Clearance accelerates the scoring plan while Your Digital Life erases the runner board.

hb_bullet_train.name: Haas-Bioroid: Precision Design
hb_bullet_train.description: A fast-advance engine turbocharged by Fully Operational and Nanomanagement. Once it gets rolling, the Corp scores out before the runner can find their answer.

nbn_fun_dreams.name: Epiphany Analytica: Nations Undivided
nbn_fun_dreams.description: A relentless asset flood backed by Cohort Guidance Program and Federal Fundraising. Vladisibirsk City Grid keeps vulnerable agendas safe while Oppo Research punishes tagged runners.

au_co_autsch_uff.name: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
au_co_autsch_uff.description: A dense asset economy anchored by Bladderwort and Cohort Guidance Program. Reaper Function and Hostile Architecture punish runners who linger in servers.

melies_grind.name: Melies U: Only the Brightest
melies_grind.description: A punishment machine built on Sisyphus Protocol and Proprionegation. Ganked!, Anoetic Void, and La Costa Grid trap runners in an endless loop of bad trades.

au_co_cloned_clones.name: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
au_co_cloned_clones.description: A clone-flooding asset engine powered by Moon Pool and Bladderwort. Measured Response and layered barriers grind out any runner who cannot keep pace.

au_co_crocodilian.name: AU Co.: The Gold Standard in Clones
au_co_crocodilian.description: A slow-grinding attrition machine powered by Blood in the Water and Bladderwort. It wins by making every run cost more than the runner can afford.
